record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Assuming N=2 vertex operator superalgebras for Calabi-Yau manifolds, their basic representation theory, and full N=2 superconformal field theories can be constructed, can physicists' conjectures about Calabi-Yau manifolds, such as quantum cohomology and mirror symmetry, be formulated and proved mathematically using those structures?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.3. Suppose that N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras corresponding to Calabi-Yau manifolds can be constructed, that the basic results in the representation theory of these algebras can be obtained and that the full N = 2 superconformal field theories can be constructed. Formulate and prove the conjectures (for example, quantum cohomology and mirror symmetry) by physicists on Calabi-Yau manifolds by turning physicists' intuition into mathematical methods using these results and constructions.

artifact.category_tag: N=2 vertex operator superalgebras and mirror symmetry
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Assume that the following can be carried out rigorously within the framework of vertex operator superalgebras and conformal field theory:

(a) For every Calabi-Yau manifold X (a compact Kähler manifold with vanishing first Chern class), one can construct an N=2 vertex operator superalgebra V_X, i.e. a vertex operator superalgebra equipped with an action of the N=2 superconformal algebra (generated by a Virasoro field L, a u(1)-current J, and two odd supercurrents G^+, G^-) with central charge c = 3·dim_C(X), that suitably encodes the geometry of X.

(b) The basic representation theory of V_X has been established: classification of irreducible modules, modular invariance of characters, fusion rules, and the structure of intertwining operator algebras.

(c) From V_X one can construct a full N=2 superconformal field theory associated to X (a consistent system of correlation functions on Riemann surfaces of arbitrary genus respecting modular invariance, locality, and the sewing axioms).

Under these assumptions, formulate and prove, purely within this mathematical framework, the physicists' conjectures concerning Calabi-Yau manifolds. In particular:

(i) Realize the quantum cohomology ring of X as a structure naturally extracted from V_X and its associated N=2 superconformal field theory (for instance, from a chiral ring of suitable BPS states or from genus-zero correlators), and prove that this structure coincides with the quantum cohomology defined by Gromov-Witten invariants of X.

(ii) Formulate mirror symmetry as an equivalence between the N=2 superconformal field theories associated to a mirror pair (X, X^∨) of Calabi-Yau manifolds, obtained by an automorphism reversing the sign of the u(1)-current J (the mirror automorphism exchanging the (a,c)- and (c,c)-rings), and prove that this equivalence implies the expected identifications between Gromov-Witten invariants of X and period integrals / variations of Hodge structure of X^∨.
artifact.status_search_result: A complete mathematical realization of the program—construction of N=2 vertex operator superalgebras for general Calabi-Yau manifolds, their full representation theory, the associated N=2 superconformal field theories, and a derivation of quantum cohomology and mirror symmetry from these—remains open. Partial progress exists (e.g., chiral de Rham complex of Malikov-Schechtman-Vaintrob, half-twisted models, Borisov's lattice constructions for toric mirror symmetry, and Kontsevich's homological mirror symmetry), but a unified rigorous formulation within N=2 VOSA/SCFT as posed is not achieved.

status_evidence.title: Chiral de Rham complex and Calabi-Yau manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of sheaves of vertex superalgebras on Calabi-Yau manifolds providing a partial mathematical realization of N=2 SCFTs.
status_evidence.claim: Partial constructions of N=2 vertex superalgebra structures from Calabi-Yau manifolds exist, but a complete framework yielding quantum cohomology and mirror symmetry has not been achieved.

status_evidence.title: Vertex algebras and mirror symmetry (Borisov)
status_evidence.snippet: Lattice vertex algebra constructions reproducing toric mirror symmetry, indicating progress but not a general solution.
status_evidence.claim: Mirror symmetry has been realized via vertex algebras only in special (toric) cases.
